description: Authenticates the customer's domain for sending email through i-mailsend (Oracle OCI Email Delivery, eu-frankfurt-1): DKIM CNAME, SPF include merged into the existing SPF record and custom return path (bounce) CNAME. Used when the domain already has a DMARC record, which is left unchanged. MX and website records are not touched.
variableDescription: dkimselector: the DKIM selector created for this domain in Oracle Email Delivery (e.g. em202610). The DKIM CNAME target is derived from it: <selector>.<fqdn>.dkim.fra1.oracleemaildelivery.com.
